message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a man kneeling in a landscape of tree stumps. The man, with dark hair and a mustache, wears a grey short-sleeved button-down shirt and matching trousers. He holds a wooden mallet in his right hand and a grey chisel in his left. He is positioned in the lower-left foreground, facing right, and appears to be carving a small house directly out of the top of a large, dark grey tree stump. The stump shows visible wood shavings scattered around its base. Dozens of similar grey tree stumps recede into the background against a textured yellow field.

Large white text at the top reads "TEMPO," with "9-15 JUNI 2014" below it. Central bold white text says "HUTAN HILANG SUAP TERBILANG." Additional white text in the upper-left states "BINTARA PENDUKUNG CAPRES" and in the upper-right "WAWANCARA ZICO: BRASIL 85 PERSEN JUARA." Smaller white text to the right mentions "KPK mencokok Bupati Bogor," "skandal alih fungsi hutan Jonggol," "Raja properti Cahyadi Kumala," and "Menteri Kehutanan terlibat?". A barcode, "RP 35.000," and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273" are at the bottom left.
